verdict.rationale: Meltano documents incremental replication state tracking so pipelines 'pick up right where the previous run left off' (meltano-docs-20, meltano-docs-30), which supports resuming from checkpoints. However, there is no evidence of automatic retry logic for transient failures (e.g., network blips, API rate limits) built into Meltano itself. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry/backoff mechanism for transient failures, evidence of partial-sync resume mid-stream (vs. only between full runs), and independent confirmation of this reliability behavior in production.
